recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-contrast composition featuring four individuals in stylized poses against a deep blue aquatic background, characterized by heavy saturation, cartoonish graphic overlays, and a playful, surreal underwater atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via primary color clothing against blue water
Graphic-to-image integration using floating bubbles and starfish
Typographic dominance through large, outlined, playful lettering at the top
coreInvariants: Heavy black and white outlines on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a staggered, overlapping row across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure in a bright orange dress serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large top-aligned text down to the central figure, then outward to the supporting figures and floating starfish.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper third around the main title and the bottom corners.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and Black (Text Outlines and Bubbles)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast on the subjects to make them pop from the dark water.

letterConstructionRules: Integrated graphic elements like swirls or eyes within counters
Irregular baseline for a bouncy feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Q' tail is stylized as a fluid wave
Counters filled with circular bubble motifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Wide-tracked small sans-serif for secondary metadata to provide breathing room.

candidateDirections.reason: Necessary to achieve the specific liquid-like warping

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep blue underwater scene with a slight vertical gradient. Place four people in 90s pop fashion (orange dress, yellow striped shirt) in a staggered row. Add floating translucent bubbles and two yellow starfish in the lower corners. Use high-contrast studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, warped, custom-lettered title at the top with a double black-and-white outline and blue fill. Add a small, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle below it on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the blue background sufficiently saturated?
Do the subjects have a 'cut-out' look against the water?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is illegible due to warping
Check that the orange dress remains the primary visual anchor
Verify the double outline on the main title is crisp
Confirm the Y2K 'plastic' aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered subjects + Saturated Blue Water + Double-Outlined Warped Display Type + Floating Aquatic Props = Y2K Pop Aesthetic
